summary: This slice is the complete Vim 101 Hacks text: front matter, 15 chapters, 101 numbered hacks, and 15 bonus hacks covering Vim basics, navigation, text manipulation, programmer features, command-line and gVim options, search, completion, and folding. Each hack is a short, example-driven recipe built from normal-mode commands, ex commands, and .vimrc settings.
